## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation this week and cyclicals leading (Industrials/Energy strong), while leadership concentration is moderate (Top 5 from 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities strong: CEG (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples soft: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION; Technology mixed with significant long-term weakness in names like INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND; NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence in several large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, SHOP) where 1W strength contrasts with 1M weakness — watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive this week: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -4.08%) RECOVERY — sector showing rotation between winners and laggards.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internally healthy: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY; Financials adding cyclical support to the RISK-ON backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively stable with pockets of divergence: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY — defensive names mixed versus biotech/large-cap rotations.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to cyclical/value names showing leadership (DE, OXY, CVX, JPM) and reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names with sustained 1M weakness (INTC, ORCL, PANW); manage position sizing given major-cap divergence between 1W and 1M signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (DE, GE) and Energy (OXY, CVX) — cyclicals driving breadth. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples where 1W weakness and headline risk (WMT, EL) could pressure sentiment.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
DE continuation above near-term resistance (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) would confirm strength; OXY to hold current breakout levels (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) for momentum; NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) holding above recent pivot would signal Tech catch-up.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) (+80): upbeat earnings/guidance — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) (+55): dividend hike — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) (+60): potential DePuy sale — price CORRECTION, sentiment diverging (watch).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) (-85): large negative headlines — price BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) (-55): program failures headline — price BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) (-45): competitive pressure headlines — price BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, favor Value/Cyclical style. DE, OXY and AMAT showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major-cap divergence (several large growth names in RECOVERY vs 1M weakness) and headline-driven Tech downside (ORCL, INTC) — watch for trend confirmation.
